verses: Alif Laam Meem
Roomi maghloob hogaye hain
Nazdeek ki zamin per aur woh maghloob honey kay baad unqareeb ghalib aajayen gay
Chand saal mein hi. Uss say pehlay aur uss kay baad bhi ikhtiyar Allah Taalaa hi ka hai. Uss roz musalman shaadmaan hun gay
Allah ki madad say, woh jiss ki chahata hai madad kerta hai. Asal ghalib aur meharban o hi hai
Allah ka wada hai, Allah Taalaa apney waday ka khilaf nahi kerta lekin aksar log nahi jantay
Woh to (sirf) dunyawi zindagi kay zahir ko (hi) jantay hain aur aakhirat say to bilkul hi bey-khabar hain

Kiya unn logon ney apney dil mein yeh ghor nahi kiya? Kay Allah Taalaa ney aasmano ko aur zamin aur unn kay darmiyan jo kuch hai sab ko behtareen qareeney say muqarrar waqt tak kay liye (hi) peda kiya hai, haan aksar log yaqeenan apney rab ki mulaqat kay munkir hain

Kiya unhon ney zamin per chal phir ker yeh nahi dekha kay unn say pehlay logon ka anjam kaisa (bura) hua? Woh unn say boht ziyadah tawana (aur taqatwar) thay aur unhon ney (bhi) zamin boee joti thi aur unn say ziyadah abad ki thi aur unn kay pass unn kay rasool roshan dalaeel ley ker aaye thay. Yeh to na-mumkin tha kay Allah Taalaa unn per zulm kerta lekin (dar-asal) woh khud apni janon per zulm kertay thay
Phir aakhir bura kerney walon ka boht hi bura anjam hua, uss liye kay woh Allah Taalaa ki aayaton ko jhutlatay aur unn ki hansi uratay thay
Allah Taalaa hi makhlooq ki ibtida kerta hai phir o hi ussay doobara peda keray ga phir tum sab ussi ki taraf lotaye jao gay
Aur jiss din qayamat qaeem hogi to gunehgar heyrat zada reh jayen gay
Aur unn kay tamam tar shareekon mein say aik bhi unn ka sifarshi na hoga aur (khud yeh bhi) apney shareekon kay munkir ho jayen gay
Aur jiss din qayamat qaeem hogi uss din (jamaten) alag alag ho jayen gi
Jo eman ker nek aemaal kertay rahey woh to jannat mein khush khush-o-khurram ker diye jayen gay
Aur jinhon ney kufur kiya tha aur humari aayaton ko aur aakhirat ki mulaqat ko jhoota thehraya tha woh sab azab mein pakar ker hazir rakhay jayen gay
Pus Allah Taalaa ki tasbeeh parha kero jab kay tum shaam kero aur jab subha kero
Tamam tareefon kay laeeq aasman o zamin mein sirf o hi hai teesray pehar ko aur zohar kay waqt bhi (uss ki pakeezgi biyan kero)
(o hi) zindah ko murdah say aur murdah ko zindah say nikalta hai. Aur o hi zamin ko uss ki maut kay baad zindah kerta hai ussi tarah tum (bhi) nikalay jao gay
Allah ki nishaniyon mein say hai kay uss ney tum ko mitti say peda kiya phir abb insan bann ker (chaltay phirtay) phel rahey ho

Aur uss ki nishaniyon mein say hai kay tumhari hi jinss say biwiyan peda kin takay tum unn say aaram pao uss ney tumharay darmiyan mohabbat aur humdardi qaeem ker di, yaqeenan ghor ghor-o-fiker kerney walon kay liye uss mein boht si nishaniyan hain
Uss (ki qudrat) ki nishaniyon mein say aasmano aur zamin ki pedaeesh aur tumhari zabano aur rangaton ka ikhtilaf (bhi) hai, danish mandon kay liye uss mein yaqeenan bari nishaniyan hain

Aur (bhi) uss ki (qudrat ki) nishani tumhari raaton aur din ki neend mein hai aur uss kay fazal (yani rozi) ko tumhara talash kerna bhi hai. Jo log (kaan laga ker) sunnay kay aadi hain unn kay liye uss mein boht si nishaniyan hain

Aur uss ki nishaniyon mein say aik yeh (bhi) hai kay woh tumhen daraney aur umeedwaar bananey kay liye bijliyan dikhata hai aur aasman say barish barsata hai aur uss murdah zamin ko zindah ker deta hai, uss mein (bhi) aqalmandon kay liye boht si nishaniyan hain
Uss ki aik nishani yeh bhi hai kay aasman o zamin ussi kay hukum say qaeem hain, phir jab woh tumhen awaz dey ga sirf aik baar ki awaz kay sath hi tum sab zamin say nikal aao gay
Aur zamin o aasman ki her her cheez uss ki milkiyat hai aur her aik uss kay farman kay ma-tehat hai

O hi hai jo awwal baar makhlooq ko peda kerta hai phir say doobara peda keray ga aur yeh to uss per boht hi aasan hai. Ussi ki behtareen aur aala sift hai, aasmano mein aur zamin mein bhi aur o hi ghalbay wala hikmat wala hai

Allah Taalaa ney tumharay liye aik misal khud tumhari hi biyan farmaee, jo kuch hum ney tumhen dey rakha hai kiya uss mein tumharay ghulamon mein say bhi koi tumhara shareek hai? Kay tum aur woh uss mein barabar darjay kay ho? Aur tum unn ka aisa khatra rakhtay ho jaisa khud apno ka, hum aqal rakhney walon kay liye ussi tarah khol khol ker aayaten biyan ker detay hain
Balkay)yeh baat yeh hai kay yeh zalim to baghair ilm kay khuwahish parasti ker rahey hain, ussay kaun raah dikhaye jissay Allah Taalaa raah say hata dey, unn ka aik bhi madadgar nahi

Pus aap yak so ho ker apna mun deen ki taraf mutawajha ker den. Allah Taalaa ki woh fitrat jiss per uss ney logon ko peda kiya hai, Allah Taalaa kay banaye ko badalna nahi, yehi seedha deen hai lekin aksar log nahi samajhtay
(logo!) Allah Taalaa ki taraf rujoo ho ker uss say dartay raho aur namaz ko qaeem rakho aur mushrikeen mein say na ho jao
Unn logon mein say jinhon ney apney deen ko tukray tukray ker diya aur khud bhi giroh giroh hogaye her giroh uss cheez per jo uss kay pass hai magan hai

Logon ko jab kabhi koi museebat phonchti hai to apney rab ki taraf (poori tarah) rujoo ho ker duayen kertay hain, phir jab woh apni taraf say rehmat ka zaeeqa chakhata hai to unn mein say aik jamat apney rab kay sath shirk kerney lagti hai
Takay woh uss cheez ki na-shukri keren jo hum ney unhen di hai acha tum faeedah utha lo! abhi abhi tumhen maloom ho jaye ga
Kiya hum ney unn per koi daleel nazil ki hai jo ussay biyan kerti hai jissay yeh Allah kay sath shareek ker rahey hain

Aur jab hum logon ko rehmat ka maza chakhatay hain to woh khoob khush ho jatay hain aur agar unhen unn kay hathon kay kartoot ki wajah say koi buraee phonchay to aik dum woh mehaz na-umeed ho jatay hain
Kiya unhon ney nahi dekha kay Allah Taalaa jissay chahaye kushadah rozi deta hai aur jissay chahaye tang, uss mein bhi unn logon kay liye jo eman latay hain nishaniyan hain
Pus qarabat daar ko miskeen ko musafir ko her aik ko uss ka haq dijiye, yeh unn kay liye behtar hai jo Allah Taalaa ka mun dekhna chahatay hun, aisay hi log nijat paney walay hain

Tum jo sood per detay ho kay logon kay maal mein barhta rahey woh Allah Taalaa kay haan nahi barhta. Aur jo kuch sadqa zakat tum Allah Taalaa ka mun dekhney (khushnoodi kay liye) do to aisay log hi apna do chand kerney walay hain

Allah Taalaa woh hai jiss ney tumhen peda kiya phir rozi di phir maar dalay ga phir zindah ker dey ga batao tumharay shareekon mein say koi bhi aisa hai jo unn mein say kuch bhi ker sakta ho. Allah Taalaa kay liye paki aur bartari hai her uss shareek say jo yeh log muqarrar kertay hain
Khushki aur tari mein logon ki aemaaliyon kay baees fasad phel gaya. Uss liye kay unhen unn kay baaz kartooton ka phal Allah Taalaa chakha dey (boht) mumkin hai kay woh baaz aajayen.
Zamin mein chal phir ker dekho to sahi kay aglon ka anjam kiya hua. Jin mein aksar log mushrik thay
Pus aap apna rukh uss sachay aur seedhay deen ki taraf hi rakhen qabal uss kay kay woh din aajaye jiss ka tal jana Allah Taalaa ki taraf say hai hi nahi, uss din sab mutafarriq ho jayen gay
Kufur kerney walon per unn kay kufur ka wabaal hoga aur nek kaam kerney walay apni hi aaram gaah sanwaar rahey hain
Takay Allah Taalaa unhen apney fazal say jaza dey jo eman laye aur nek aemaal kiye woh kafiron ko dost nahi rakhta hai

Uss ki nishaniyon mein say khushkhabriyan denay wali hawaon ko chalana bhi hai uss liye kay tumhen apni rehmat say lutf andoz keray, aur uss liye kay uss kay hukum say kashtiyan chalen, aur uss liye kay uss kay fazal ko tum dhondo, aur uss liye kay tum shukar guzari kero
Aur hum ney aap say pehlay bhi apney rasoolon ko unn ki qom ki taraf bheja woh unn kay pass daleelen laye. Phir hum ney gunah gaaron say intiqam liya. Hum per mominon ki madad kerna lazim hai

Allah Taalaa hawayen chalata hai woh abar ko uthati hain phir Allah Taalaa apni mansha kay mutabiq ussay aasman mein phela deta hai aur uss kay tukray tukray ker deta hai phir aap dekhtay hain kay uss andar say qatray nikaltay hain, aur jinhen Allah chahata hai unn bandon per pani barsata hai to woh khush khush ho jatay hain
Yaqeen manna kay barish unn per barasney say pehlay pehlay to woh na-umeed ho rahey thay

Pus aap rehmat elahi kay aasaar dekhen kay zamin ki maut kay baad kiss tarah Allah Taalaa ussay zindah ker deta hai? Kuch shak nahi kay o hi mardon ko zindah kerney wala hai, aur woh her her cheez per qadir hai
Aur agar hum baad tund chala den aur yeh log unhi kheton ko (mujahee hui) zard pari hui dekh len to phir uss kay baad na-shukri kerney lagen
Be-shak aap mardon ko nahi suna saktay aur na behron ko (apni) awaz suna saktay hain jab kay woh peeth pher ker murr gaye hun
Aur na aap andhon ko unn ki gumrahi say hidayat kerney walay hain aap to sirf unn hi logon ko sunatay hain jo humari aayaton per eman rakhtay hain pus o hi ita’at kerney walay hain

Allah Taalaa woh hai jiss ney tumhen kamzori ki halat mein peda kiya phir uss kamzori kay baad tawanaee di, phir uss tawanaee kay baad kamzori aur burhapa diya jo chahata hai peda kerta hai, woh sab say poora waqif aur sab per poora qadir hai
Aur jiss din qayamat barpa ho jaye gi gunah gaar log qasmen khayen gay kay (duniya mein) aik ghari kay siwa nahi thehray, ussi tarah yeh behkay huye hi rahey

Aur jin logon ko ilm aur eman diya gaya woh jawab den gay kay tum to jaisa kay kitab Allah mein hai yaum qayamat tak thehray rahey. Aaj ka yeh din qayamat hi ka din hai lekin tum to yaqeen hi nahi mantay thay
Pus uss din zalimon ko unn ka uzur bahana kuch kaam na aaye ga aur na unn say tauba aur amal talab kiya jaye ga
Be-shak hum ney uss Quran mein logon kay samney kul misalen biyan ker di hain. Aap unn kay pass koi bhi nishani layen, yeh kafir to yehi kahen gay kay tum (bey ho deh go) bilkul jhootay ho
Allah Taalaa unn logon kay dilon per jo samajh nahi rakhtay yun hi mehar ker deta hai
Pus aap sabar keren yaqeenan Allah ka wada sacha hai. Aap ko woh log halka (bey sabra) na keren yaqeen nahi rakhtay
